02 / ABOUT US
Since 1982

Rooted in Puerto Rico.
Driven by science.

A family-owned company serving the scientific community across Puerto Rico and the Caribbean.

Founded in 1982, Caribbean Scientific is a family-owned company dedicated to the distribution of laboratory and process equipment, instrumentation, and supplies for the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and educational sectors. With over three decades of industry expertise, we have built a strong reputation for excellence in both product distribution and technical service.

Originally launched as Filtration Instrumentation Specialist, Inc. (FIS), our journey began with a single sales division focused on laboratory solutions. In 1992, we expanded our capabilities by establishing VCI, Inc., a sister company focused exclusively on equipment service. Recognizing the value of integrated support, the two entities merged in 2002 to form FIS-VCI, Inc., unifying our distribution and service divisions under one name.

Today, Caribbean Scientific is recognized for delivering a superior service experience. Our dedicated team of sales professionals and technical experts work closely with clients to understand their unique needs and provide tailored solutions across a broad portfolio of laboratory products and services.

Our Service Division is staffed by certified technicians trained to calibrate, validate, repair, and maintain a wide range of laboratory equipment, with a strong emphasis on refrigeration systems and particle counters—two of the most critical areas for pharmaceutical and cleanroom operations.

We are proud to serve clients throughout Puerto Rico and the Caribbean Islands, offering prompt, reliable, and high-quality service and distribution. Our mission is to support your success with solutions that enhance the performance, compliance, and reliability of your operations.

03 / MISSION & VISION
Our direction

A purpose behind every solution.

Our Mission

At Caribbean Scientific, our mission is to support the scientific community by connecting people with the tools and services they need to keep moving forward. Whether it’s lab equipment, process instrumentation, or specialized service support, we’re here to make sure everything works the way it should — so you can focus on what really matters.

We keep up with the latest innovations to bring our clients smart, reliable solutions. But more than that, we take pride in being responsive, honest, and easy to work with. Our team uses modern tools and hands-on experience to deliver quality service and we do it with a genuine commitment to the people and communities we serve.

Our Vision

At Caribbean Scientific, our vision is simple we want to be the team you trust. Whether you’re running a lab, teaching the next generation of scientists, or leading research in the field, we’re here to make sure you have the tools, equipment, and support you need to do your best work.

We take pride in giving every project our full attention, no matter the size. We may be a small business, but we treat our clients like family with care, respect, and a genuine commitment to getting things done right. Our goal is to make a difference by offering dependable solutions and building lasting relationships along the way.

04 / QUALITY POLICY
Our official commitment

Quality is a promise we keep.

Customer satisfaction and continual improvement are central to our quality policy.

Caribbean Scientific is committed to customer satisfaction. We gain customer satisfaction by providing excellent service, knowledgeable application assistance, a quality product that meets or exceeds the customers’ expectations, and superior after-sales service.

To assure that we continue to meet customer expectations, Caribbean Scientific management establishes goals and objectives that promote continual improvement.

Official source: SOP-QPP-MAN · Revision 4.0 · 13-Jul-2026. Refer to the controlled Quality Manual for the current version.

05 / EQUIPMENT JOURNEY
From arrival to return

Every step has a purpose.

Follow the ten stages of how customer equipment moves through our service process.

01
Receiving Area

Receipt

Equipment physically arrives and remains pending registration / ERP entry.

02
Customer Service

Verify

Verify customer information, equipment identification, accompanying documentation and requested service.

03
Customer Service

Inspect & Document

Perform visual inspection and document received condition, accessories and applicable customer requirements.

04
Customer Service

Identify, Tag & Register

Complete the Service Repair Tag and create / complete the Work Order in Odoo. Establish traceability.

05
IER-01 – Incoming Equipment Rack

Ready for Service

Move registered and properly identified equipment to the designated incoming location, ready for technical service.

06
Applicable Service / Calibration Area

Service Activities

Authorized technical personnel perform the applicable calibration, maintenance, repair, diagnostic or technical service.

07
Applicable In Process Location

In Process

Equipment remains identified while active or pending parts, evaluation, customer response or another service-related activity.

08
RER-01 – Ready Equipment Rack

Finished Job

Completed equipment is transferred to the Finished Jobs / Ready Equipment location pending return.

09
From Finished Jobs / RER-01

Return to Customer

Coordinate shipment, delivery or customer pickup while maintaining appropriate protection and identification.

10
Administrative Closure

Service Closure

Complete applicable certificate delivery, service documentation and closure records.
